release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.2 Above-Indicator Chair Text Layout & Auto-Clash Resolution:
• Precision Above-Indicator Chair Text Layout: Implemented custom chair text placement rules for both orthogonal and angled tendons. Longitude tendons place elevation text with 0° rotation directly above the indicator (+Y) with a 50 mm offset. Latitude tendons place elevation text rotated 90° along the tendon, offset strictly to the left of the indicator (-X) by 50 mm, preventing overlaps in dense tendon bands.
• Intelligent Chair Clash Detection: In 'Beside' placement mode, chair text automatically promotes to the above-indicator layout only when interference occurs with adjacent cables (spacing <= 550 mm) or neighboring chairs (proximity <= 600 mm), while preserving clean 'Beside' placement everywhere else.
• Continuous Interior Tendon Spacing Dimensions: Fixed subgroup boundary handling ensuring full collinear dimension chains across interior tendon corridors in DXF export.
